items.summary: Recommendation: maintain financial containment. Do not authorize a control-plane prototype, spend, new commitments, or production work this cycle. The three workflow concepts may remain deferred, but their financial benefit and engineering cost are not calculable from the brief. Evidence is limited to 282 approved proposals, 187 without execution requests, 9 failed implementation requests, 47 open repair follow-ups, 28 improvements awaiting measurement, and 2 proven outcomes. These are operational metrics, not financial returns. Revenue supports only 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission; $0 is site-attributed, and the aggregate row cannot be assigned to sites. AI usage reports $973.3548129 across 5,439 calls from 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-27, while retained cost records conflict. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure remain unknown. Continue existing reconciliation only.

Minimum measurement before approving financial expansion: reconcile one identical reporting window for provider revenue and tracking IDs, AI cost, infrastructure, domains, labor, marketing, and approved budgets; preserve aggregate revenue separately from site-attributed revenue; and record baseline, incremental cost, and defined learning result for each workflow or experiment. Until then, do not treat impressions, clicks, rankings, sessions, conversions, ordered items without attributable commission, technical scores, or AI call counts as financial returns.
